text: 一人で旅行しています

literal: 教師 avoids self-describing with the honorific 先生, which is how a teacher is addressed by others, not how they refer to their own occupation
看護師 is the gender-neutral term mandated since the 2002 renaming of 看護婦 (female-only)
'company employee' -- the ordinary Japanese self-description for office/white-collar work, more idiomatic than a literal 'I work in an office'
母, the humble word for one's own mother, not お母さん -- matching this pack's own this-is-my-husband row (夫, not ご主人)
父, the humble word for one's own father, not お父さん
elder brother (兄 is also the humble self-reference form); text_alt 弟 is the younger-brother word -- Japanese marks relative age and has no sibling term unmarked for it
elder sister (姉 is also the humble self-reference form); text_alt 妹 is the younger-sister word

text: こちらはパートナーです
literal: パートナー is the gender-neutral term used in Japan's municipal partnership-registry systems (パートナーシップ制度), avoiding 恋人's romance-only reading and 主人/嫁's marriage-only one
